description.short_caption: Forearm with erythema, swelling, and ecchymosis suggestive of soft tissue infection.
description.detailed_description: The image shows a patient's forearm with visible erythema, swelling, and areas of ecchymosis extending from the wrist to the mid-forearm. The discoloration appears dark red to purple, consistent with inflammation or possible necrosis. A healthcare provider is holding the patient's arm, wearing gloves, suggesting clinical examination. The findings are suggestive of a severe soft tissue infection, possibly cellulitis or necrotizing fasciitis.
